feature: Boards saved as state only (0.23.0, or before Done made a picture on 2026-10-22) show their drawing on the card: each card in view draws an off-screen preview from its state, one at a time, cached by the raster key; time from the cards mounting to every preview decoded on screen
scale: 20 legacy boards in view at once (opening fits the canvas to its nodes: 76% in the 1280x933 window), each 1280x720 with 2 placed photographs from 6 distinct frames of the repository real AI shot (640x360), 12 brush paths and a line of text, all different (no cache hits); the project is opened by double click on its card
budgetBasis: Default open-to-interactive budget (<=1 s, Nielsen 1 s limit for keeping the flow of thought) from docs/engineering/perf-scenarios.md, applied to the part this feature adds to opening a project: from the twenty cards mounting to all twenty drawn previews on screen. The cold open before the cards mount has its own scenario (project-open-100-nodes); the probe also prints double click to all previews (projectOpenToPreviewsMs) and the longest task in the window (longestTaskMs).
